tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Find published article titles and physical service listings. Matches every query word in the title. Follow next_cursor with the same query and kind to read more.

tools.name: read_resource
tools.description: Read a resource returned by search_resources. Returns native Markdown when available, or the canonical HTML link for preserved legacy articles. Accepts catalog IDs, never arbitrary URLs or file paths.

tools.name: read_company_profile
tools.description: Read Leviathan Systems' public company identity, physical service scope, exclusions and contact guidance. Select a smaller view when only services or scope boundaries are needed.
